'''Ghost troll lout''' is a [[monster]] that, together with a [[ghost troll brute]], must be killed during the [[Necromancy!]] tutorial quest by using [[Necromancy]].

They both should pose no great challenge for any player.

Despite appearing as a ghost, they don't count for the [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)|Slayer assignment for ghosts]].
